commits: test: strengthen stale evidence recovery coverage

requirements.desc: A stale test evidence recovery after a material implementation change shall create or resume one TestEvidenceRefreshPurpose transaction whose manifest hash, ledger tail currentHash, delta currentHash, and reported currentFingerprint equal the current repair fingerprint.
requirements.note: R1: committed refresh aligns manifest ledger delta and result fingerprint

requirements.desc: When an impl-repair ledger already exists, the refresh entry shall append exactly once with previousHash equal to the prior ledger tail currentHash, a non-empty changed-path delta, and invalidation records equal to the transaction's staged artifact set.
requirements.note: R2: refresh appends one continuous ledger entry after retry

requirements.desc: Integration gate, final-regression, and acceptance-review stale evidence entrypoints shall delegate lifecycle transition and repair effects to the same existing impl-repair transaction authority without adding another mutation owner.
requirements.note: R3: every stale entrypoint uses the owned lifecycle transition authority

requirements.desc: Recovery shall report success only after the owned transaction has committed its delta, ledger, manifest, artifact invalidation, and test-execute lifecycle transition, and no consumer shall accept a pending or partially applied transaction as current evidence.
requirements.note: R4: failed effects remain pending and never report recovered success

requirements.desc: A retry after each injected durable failure boundary shall either roll the identical owned transaction forward exactly once or fail closed; it shall not duplicate ledger entries, lose stale artifacts without a committed transition, or return a partial recovered result.
requirements.note: R5: every durable effects boundary converges exactly once

requirements.desc: Valid evidence already matching the current fingerprint shall retain its normal path, while malformed evidence, inconsistent fingerprints, foreign pending transactions, changed material authority, and run/spec/Issue target mismatches shall fail closed without recovery mutation.
requirements.note: R6: changed target identity rejects a pending refresh without mutation

requirements.desc: After committed recovery, the normal flow shall regenerate current evidence through test-execute, test-result-review, impl-review, impl-gate, retro, and acceptance-review without impl-repair ledger schema rejection.
requirements.note: R7: committed recovery regenerates evidence through the real CLI lifecycle

requirements.desc: The public recovery behavior of integration gate, final-regression, acceptance-review, and explicit rewind-test-evidence shall retain its existing result fields, next step, exact target guards, and fail-closed structural validation.
requirements.note: R8: public entrypoints preserve recovery projections and rewind guards

requirements.desc: Spec-local requirement tests and affected shared unit and CLI lifecycle tests shall cover existing-ledger continuity, all stale recovery entrypoints, durable failure boundaries, current evidence, malformed evidence, and target authority mismatches.
requirements.note: R9: affected shared recovery unit suites execute as regression evidence

entries.reason: Draft gate passed but preset-chain resolution emitted a non-blocking node-cli preset warning
entries.resolution: No workaround applied because the gate result and evidence were valid; recorded the out-of-scope warning for follow-up

entries.reason: Initial spec-local tests bypassed public recovery entrypoints and under-asserted lifecycle coverage
entries.resolution: Added executable gate, final-regression, acceptance refresh, and rewind guard calls plus delta, invalidation, regenerated evidence, malformed, current, and target mismatch assertions

entries.reason: Second test review found malformed evidence expectations and rewind plus authority edge cases incomplete
entries.resolution: Routed malformed JSON through integration validation, added successful explicit rewind command coverage, and added foreign pending transaction plus changed material authority assertions

entries.reason: Third test review found no public current-evidence path and no assertion excluding direct mutation ownership
entries.resolution: Added a current-fingerprint final-regression pass case and counted only mutations made without an owned transaction intent, asserting zero such calls for all refresh entrypoints

entries.reason: Static test review exhausted after four executable coverage gaps remained
entries.resolution: Replaced fabricated lifecycle evidence with the shared CLI lifecycle, added exact guard mismatches, ran affected shared suites, and counted every mutation call

entries.reason: Review retry reset rejected uncommitted test repairs as unchanged identity
entries.resolution: Committed the bounded test-design repairs on the feature branch so HEAD tree identity reflects changed evidence

entries.reason: Changed-evidence review found pending-consumer and shared-coverage mapping gaps
entries.resolution: Added pending consumer recovery assertions and a dedicated R9 shared-suite regression adapter tracked by the coverage artifact

entries.reason: test artifact validation failed: spec-local requirement tests failed: R4, R7, R9
Gate evidence exposed three spec-local failures: cross-entrypoint journal resume rejected matching authority, and nested Node suites inherited NODE_TEST_CONTEXT.
entries.resolution: Allowed an exact journal/state transaction to resume independently of the detecting entrypoint and isolated nested test subprocesses from the parent Node test context.

entries.reason: Acceptance found the repair ledger tail behind the current fingerprint because post-gate test fixes had been re-executed without a new owned refresh transaction.
entries.resolution: Introduced the final fixture cleanup as a material change so acceptance stale-evidence recovery can append the canonical transaction from the existing ledger tail and regenerate downstream evidence.

entries.reason: R9 exposed an outdated final-regression fixture without the v2 manifest or canonical persisted flow target, plus a Node version command affected by the parent test context.
entries.resolution: Made the shared fixture exercise the real FlowManager with canonical spec.json and a persisted manifest, and used an independent successful command for the current-evidence control case.

fix: centralize repeated serialized value equality
entries.resolution: ImplRepairTargetIdentity.equals and ImplRepairTransaction.equals now delegate the identical toJSON serialization comparison to one local helper, removing the duplicated production pattern without changing equality semantics.

entries.resolution: continue to final-regression with accepted risk
